title: vivo Officially Launches Intelligent Agent Large Model Matrix and Announces Significant Research on 30B MoE Edge-side Large Model
excerpt: vivo officially held a launch event today, introducing a new intelligent large model matrix, including four core large models covering voice, terminal-side, clo
content_html:
vivo officially held a launch event today, introducing a new intelligent large model matrix, including four core large models covering voice, terminal-side, cloud-side, and more, comprehensively empowering the intelligent experience of terminal devices. At the same time, vivo officially announced that it is accelerating the pre-research of BlueMind 30B MoE terminal-side large model, committed to exploring how to bring the potential of trillion-level large models to run on mobile phones, to achieve stronger multimodal understanding, long-chain reasoning, and complex task execution.

Aside from the powerful large model matrix, vivo also experienced a comprehensive upgrade in software and system ecology. At this event, the preview version of vivo's original programming intelligent agent BlueCode was officially unveiled, providing developers and tech enthusiasts with a new terminal-side intelligent productivity tool.

In terms of the underlying operating system, the new OriginOS7 and the self-developed BlueLake OS 4 were also launched simultaneously. By deeply integrating large model technology with the system's underlying architecture, vivo is accelerating the construction of a new AI operating system paradigm that combines software and hardware, continuously solidifying its innovative steps in the field of terminal artificial intelligence.
